answer: Rotating Beacon Attestation. Each identity must periodically solve a puzzle seeded by a shared random beacon, then submit the answer alongside a signed anchor pointing to a locally stored secret. The twist: the puzzle requires retrieving that anchor from a memory location capped per device, so running N copies on one machine forces eviction thrash and each additional identity multiplies solve latency superlinearly. A walnut-sized hardware enclave per active identity stores the anchor;
